archetypes.name: shared-consumers
archetypes.rationale: Shared voter/tally changes could silently alter /review, /research, or /implement behavior despite the plan's backward-compatibility claims.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the proposed shared-script edits are truly additive and gated to plan-review callers only. Compare the plan's flag threading and detector additions against every listed shared consumer path, looking for default-output drift, changed tally semantics, or undocumented caller obligations. Pay special attention to render-voter-prompt, dispatch-plan-voters, lib-vote-tally, and aggregate-findings interactions outside /design. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: marker-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: The [SCOPE-REDUCTION] tag is the core contract, so any lifecycle mismatch would defeat the proposed scope-cut protection.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace the proposed [SCOPE-REDUCTION] marker from reviewer prompt emission through aggregation, ballot blocks, vote rendering, tally detection, and accepted-findings output. Look for gaps where the tag could be stripped, escaped, fenced, merged away, or detected from the wrong artifact. Check whether the plan's unfenced-literal semantics align with existing parser and block-file boundaries. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: scope-anchor-flow
archetypes.rationale: The issue-anchor fix spans scout, reviewer, voter, and loop wiring, making missing or inconsistent propagation a likely plan defect.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify that the originating issue and baseline plan are introduced at the correct pipeline points and remain consistent across SIMPLE and HARD paths. Compare the planned flag names, snapshot timing, graceful-degrade behavior, and caller wiring against the existing script responsibilities. Hunt for places where the scout or voters may still operate from the drifting plan or findings-only context. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
